queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Splashtop Business' AND publisher = 'Splashtop Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Splashtop Business' AND publisher = 'Splashtop Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '3.8.601.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('strwinclt.exe','src.exe','clientoobe.exe','strwinsession.exe'));
